newsitem.title: USA: Defense Secretary's brother under investigation.
newsitem.headline: Defense Secretary's brother under investigation.

text.p: The brother of U.S. Defence Secretary William Cohen is under investigation following an overnight shooting incident, police said on Wednesday.

Authorities said Robert Cohen shot and wounded a man who entered his home last night, but so far no charges have been filed. The man, whose name has not been released, was hit several times in the neck and is being treated at a local hospital.

"The central issue at this point is whether or not the homeowner in the incident was justified in using the deadly force that he did with respect to this intruder," Penobscott County District Attorney Christopher Almy said.
The victim's wounds -- caused by a small caliber handgun -- were not believed to be life threatening, police said.
Other details about the shooting remain vague.
Robert is William Cohen's older brother and runs the family's central Maine baking business. The Cohens were born and raised in the neighboring city of Bangor.
